drivingQuestion: Does the mishna support Shmuel that halitza with the woman who received maamar does not exempt her rival?
outcomeNote: the suggestion is tested and rejected in the next unit

segments.he: כֵּיצַד — מַאֲמָר לָזוֹ וְכוּ׳. לֵימָא מְסַיַּיע לֵיהּ לִשְׁמוּאֵל, דְּאָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: חָלַץ לְבַעֲלַת מַאֲמָר — לֹא נִפְטְרָה צָרָתָהּ.
segments.en: The mishna further teaches: «How so?» If he performed «levirate betrothal with this» one and performed ḥalitza with that one, the first woman requires a bill of divorce to cancel the levirate betrothal. The Gemara suggests: «Let us say» that this teaching «supports» the opinion of «Shmuel. As Shmuel said:» If a yavam «performed ḥalitza with» the woman «who received levirate betrothal,» then the «rival wife is not exempt» as this ḥalitza is invalid. The fact that the Gemara does not state that the ḥalitza be performed with the woman who received levirate betrothal indicates that this ḥalitza is not a valid ḥalitza and would not be sufficient to exempt the rival wife.
